assertion_labels.label: unsupported
assertion_labels.rationale: USES_METHOD(W3038572442 -> Dense Retrieval). Ontology defines USES_METHOD as 'applies or builds on a method without originating it'. The chunk says 'a production DR model' where DR is the pre-change production model class the paper studies a swap away from. The ANCE paper does not 'use' generic Dense Retrieval; it studies what happens when a DR-based production system is retrained. The chosen ontology edge does not fit the science.

assertion_labels.label: unsupported
assertion_labels.rationale: USES_METHOD(W3038572442 -> ANCE). The ANCE paper *originates* ANCE; the ontology explicitly excludes the originating paper from USES_METHOD ('applies or builds on a method without originating it'). The correct edge would be PROPOSES (corpus-context true, in-chunk only weakly supported) or no edge at all. False-positive relation type.

possible_false_negatives.rationale: Token 'Answer Coverage' is literally present in the chunk text inside the evidence span of both EVALUATES_ON assertions: '\caption{Retrieval results (Answer Coverage at Top-20/100) on ...}'.
